subject: Retrospective notes — Sprint 41
body_html:
Team,

Notes from today's retrospective:
What went well: CI pipeline stability improved, fewer production incidents.
What to improve: PR review turnaround time, test coverage.
Action items: Each developer adds 2 unit tests per PR from Sprint 42 onward.

Iris
